text: MOUNT MAUNGANUI DISASTER: Landslide Buries Campsite | Helicopter Rooftop Rescues | LIVE N18GA state of local emergency has been declared across five regions of New Zealand’s North Island after record-breaking "threat to life" rainstorms triggered a devastating landslide at Mount Maunganui. At 9:30 AM on Thursday, a massive section of the Mauao hillside collapsed onto the Beachside Holiday Park, swamping campervans, tents, and a shower block. Helicopter teams are currently working to retrieve families from rooftops in nearby Punaruku and Te Araroa, while search and rescue dogs comb the rubble at the Mount for those still unaccounted for.
